reports.title: About this dashboard
reports.query:
**Haystack x Neo4j workshop.** Same LLM, same prompt: vector RAG retrieves passages that *look like* the question,
GraphRAG adds 2-hop entity facts from the graph. Eval: 22 questions on a fictional company (8 single-hop, 14 multi-hop), 3 runs, LLM judge.
Built by `exercises/09_graphrag.py`, `10_eval_rag_vs_graphrag.py`, `eval_to_neo4j.py`.

reports.title: GraphRAG accuracy
reports.query: MATCH (:EvalVariant {name: 'graphrag'})-[a:ANSWERED]->() RETURN toString(toInteger(round(100 * avg(a.accuracy)))) + ' %' AS `GraphRAG accuracy`

reports.title: Vector RAG accuracy
reports.query: MATCH (:EvalVariant {name: 'vector'})-[a:ANSWERED]->() RETURN toString(toInteger(round(100 * avg(a.accuracy)))) + ' %' AS `Vector RAG accuracy`

reports.title: Multi-hop gain (GraphRAG - vector)
reports.query:
MATCH (v:EvalVariant)-[a:ANSWERED]->(q:EvalQuestion) WHERE q.hops > 1
WITH v.name AS variant, avg(a.accuracy) AS acc
WITH collect([variant, acc]) AS rows
RETURN '+' + toString(toInteger(round(100 * ([r IN rows WHERE r[0] = 'graphrag'][0][1] - [r IN rows WHERE r[0] = 'vector'][0][1])))) + ' pts' AS `Multi-hop gain`

reports.title: Accuracy % by variant and question type
reports.query:
MATCH (v:EvalVariant)-[a:ANSWERED]->(q:EvalQuestion)
WITH v.name AS variant, avg(CASE WHEN q.hops = 1 THEN a.accuracy END) AS single, avg(CASE WHEN q.hops > 1 THEN a.accuracy END) AS multi
RETURN variant, toInteger(round(100 * single)) AS `1-hop`, toInteger(round(100 * multi)) AS `multi-hop`
ORDER BY `multi-hop`

reports.title: Cost: avg prompt context (tokens)
reports.query: MATCH (v:EvalVariant)-[a:ANSWERED]->() RETURN v.name AS variant, toInteger(round(avg(a.ctx_tokens))) AS ctx_tokens ORDER BY ctx_tokens

reports.title: Per-question accuracy % (3 runs)
reports.query:
MATCH (q:EvalQuestion)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:EvalVariant {name: 'vector'})-[v:ANSWERED]->(q)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:EvalVariant {name: 'vector_k8'})-[k:ANSWERED]->(q)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:EvalVariant {name: 'graphrag'})-[g:ANSWERED]->(q)
RETURN q.id AS id, q.hops AS hops, q.question AS question, q.answer AS reference,
       toInteger(round(100 * v.accuracy)) AS vector, toInteger(round(100 * k.accuracy)) AS vector_k8, toInteger(round(100 * g.accuracy)) AS graphrag
ORDER BY q.hops, q.id

reports.title: Chunks
reports.query: MATCH (c:GraphRagChunk) RETURN count(c) AS Chunks

reports.title: Entities
reports.query: MATCH (e:GraphRagEntity) RETURN count(e) AS Entities

reports.title: Relations
reports.query: MATCH (:GraphRagEntity)-[r:REL]->(:GraphRagEntity) RETURN count(r) AS Relations

reports.title: Multi-hop: Project Halcyon -> lead -> manager -> office
reports.query:
MATCH p = (:GraphRagEntity {key: 'project halcyon'})-[:REL*1..3]-(:GraphRagEntity {type: 'Location'})
RETURN p LIMIT 25

reports.title: Entity types extracted by the LLM
reports.query: MATCH (e:GraphRagEntity) RETURN e.type AS type, count(*) AS entities ORDER BY entities DESC

reports.title: Entity graph
reports.query: MATCH p = (:GraphRagEntity)-[:REL]->(:GraphRagEntity) RETURN p

reports.title: Most connected entities
reports.query:
MATCH (e:GraphRagEntity)
RETURN e.name AS entity, e.type AS type, COUNT { (e)-[:REL]-() } AS relations, COUNT { (:GraphRagChunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(e) } AS chunks
ORDER BY relations DESC LIMIT 15

reports.title: Entities each eval question depends on
reports.query:
MATCH (q:EvalQuestion)-[:ABOUT]->(e:GraphRagEntity)
RETURN q.id AS id, q.question AS question, collect(e.name) AS entities ORDER BY id

reports.title: What the agent remembers (current facts)
reports.query:
MATCH (:MemoryUser {id: 'demo-user'})-[:REMEMBERS]->(a)-[r:MEM_REL]->(b) WHERE r.valid_to IS NULL
RETURN a, r, b

reports.title: Fact history incl. corrections
reports.query:
MATCH (:MemoryUser {id: 'demo-user'})-[:REMEMBERS]->(a)-[r:MEM_REL]->(b)
RETURN a.name AS subject, r.type AS relation, b.name AS object,
       toString(r.ts) AS stored, toString(r.valid_to) AS forgotten,
       CASE WHEN r.valid_to IS NULL THEN 'current' ELSE 'superseded' END AS status
ORDER BY status, stored

reports.title: Chat history per session
reports.query:
MATCH (:MemoryUser {id: 'demo-user'})-[:HAS_SESSION]->(s)-[:HAS_MESSAGE]->(m)
RETURN s.id AS session, m.seq AS seq, m.role AS role, left(m.text, 160) AS text ORDER BY session, seq

reports.title: Documents per store
reports.query:
MATCH (d) WHERE d:HaystackDocument OR d:HaystackRagDocument OR d:GraphRagChunk
RETURN labels(d)[0] AS store, count(d) AS documents, count(d.embedding) AS with_embedding ORDER BY store

reports.title: Vector RAG chunks (exercise 08)
reports.query: MATCH (d:HaystackRagDocument) RETURN d.`meta.split_id` AS split, left(d.content, 200) AS content ORDER BY split
